newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle few bids $104/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle few bids $104/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids were mostly $102.00-$103.00, with a few at $104.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and passed by owners asking $105.00-$106.00, market sources said.
Sales last week were $102.00 to $103.00 and in large enough movement to keep feedlots current, they said.
There were no bids reported on a live basis, but owners were pricing cattle at $65.00. There were a few light sales Friday at $64.00, but most sold at $63.00-$63.50.
This week's showlist was pegged at 93,800 head, up 5,000 from last week, the market sources said.
